annotation.summary_en: A young thug mocks an old man for installing a security alarm on his battered, worthless Zaporozhets car.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: In an outdoor garage parking lot, an old man named Yuri (Yurik) is sitting inside his extremely weathered and battered Zaporozhets (ZAZ). A young man wearing sunglasses, Volodik, approaches and begins pestering him with exaggerated hand gestures. Volodik mocks the old car's low ground clearance and suggests that Yuri, as a friend of his father, deserves a much better vehicle like a BMW X6 or a Lexus LX. He warns Yuri that he will eventually hit the undercarriage and spend a fortune on repairs. When Yuri tells him to leave so he can finish his work, Volodik asks what kind of 'work' could possibly be done on such a junker. Yuri reveals he is installing a security alarm system. Volodik bursts into laughter, questioning who would ever want to steal a Zaporozhets. Yuri delivers the punchline, explaining that while people steal expensive cars, they only use his car as a place to relieve themselves.

էդ ձեր մաշնեքն են թալում իմի մեջ գալի չիշիկ են անում
